_note: Single source of truth for Line of Command V1 balance numbers. spec.md quotes these values; if they disagree, this file wins and spec.md is the bug.
status: D1 DECIDED 2026-11-22 (captain): live click during first viewing + optional standing order
rally_status: D8 DECIDED 2026-11-22 (captain): rally stays at 12%; UI and narration state the gain and the 2-turn steadiness explicitly (narration.json rally, rally_ui_label)

battle_input._note: Part of each army's input to the pure resolver. Both fields optional.

strength_below_pct.meaning: own strength (front+reserve) < value% of starting strength

standing_order.evaluated: end of each tick, after the rout check, only if neither side routed; condition uses post-tick state
standing_order.send_tick: the tick whose end-of-tick check first passes

live_click.allowed: only during the FIRST viewing of a ranked battle, while the messenger is unsent and the battle is undecided at the tick being shown
live_click.maps_to: live_send_tick = index of the tick currently displayed when clicked (the order counts as sent at the end of that tick)
live_click.rerun: client re-runs resolve_battle with the same seed and live_send_tick set; ticks 1..live_send_tick are identical, so playback continues from the next tick without a jump

first_viewing_controls.skip_to_end: allowed; skipping forfeits any unsent live click (standing order still applies)

live_click.if_player_quits_mid_viewing: battle is finalised with live_send_tick as recorded so far (null if never clicked); standing order still applies
live_click.battle_counts_toward_daily_limit: when first viewing starts (quitting does not refund it)

conflict_rule: One messenger only. If both a standing order and a live click exist, the one with the earlier send_tick is used and the other is cancelled (logged standing_order_cancelled / live_click_ignored). Same tick: the live click wins. Once the messenger has been sent, the button is disabled.
rewatch: After first viewing ends, the battle record stores the final inputs (armies incl. messenger fields, terrain, seed) and the log. Re-watches replay that log; the messenger is fixed and cannot be changed or added. Replays and shared links always re-derive the identical log from the stored inputs.

auto_reserves._note: If reserves are still waiting, the officer commits them himself at the stance's auto_reserve_tick or when morale drops below the threshold, with no bonus.

no_effect_cases: commit_reserves with no reserves left: messenger wasted, logged
an order whose arrival tick comes after the battle ended: never arrives, logged as messenger_lost
rally when side already routed: not possible
